name: blurb
description: Blurb — an AI desktop pet with a little world, a desktop overlay mode, and a live fan viewer.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @blurb/web && npm run build -w @blurb/server && npm run build -w @blurb/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/render && tsc -p packages/llm && tsc -p packages/host && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p packages/desktop
